title: PAUSE: Search-Free Steering of Coding Agents Before Their First Source-Code Edit
abstract: arXiv:2610.29870v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Coding agents can invest substantial effort in repository exploration and testing yet still produce unsuccessful patches. Existing online steering methods review trajectories periodically or invoke an advisor when a monitor detects behavioral problems; frequent reviews are costly, and the absence of anomalous behavior does not mean that an agent is on the right track. We propose PAUSE, a framework for steering coding agents with a single planning intervention. Agents reach their first source-code edit at a median of 60% of trajectory progress, after exploration, bug reproduction, and testing. PAUSE intercepts this edit request before it executes, which requires no learned monitor, no search over checkpoints, and no extra model call (search-free). A separate Planner reads the task and the pre-edit transcript and writes one repair plan; the same agent, the Executor, resumes with this plan, keeping its context and workspace. PAUSE applies o

translated_title: PAUSE：在编码智能体首次源代码编辑之前的免搜索式引导
translated_abstract: 编码智能体可能在代码仓库探索和测试上投入大量精力，却仍然生成不成功的补丁。现有的在线引导方法要么周期性地审查智能体的执行轨迹，要么在监控器检测到行为异常时调用顾问；频繁的审查代价高昂，而且没有出现异常行为也并不代表智能体走在正确的道路上。我们提出PAUSE，一个通过单次规划干预来引导编码智能体的框架。智能体在完成探索、缺陷复现和测试之后，大约在轨迹进度的60%（中位数）处才会进行第一次源代码编辑。PAUSE在该编辑请求执行之前将其拦截，这既不需要学习得到的监控器，也不需要在检查点上进行搜索，更不需要额外的模型调用（免搜索）。一个独立的规划器读取任务描述和编辑前的对话记录，撰写一份修复计划；随后同一个智能体（作为执行器）带着该计划继续运行，并保留其原有的上下文和工作区。PAUSE应用o……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: PAUSE通过在编码智能体第一次修改源代码前拦截其编辑请求、由独立规划器一次性生成修复计划，实现无需监控器、无需检查点搜索、无额外模型调用的单次干预式智能体引导。
en_tdlr: PAUSE steers coding agents with a single planning intervention by intercepting their first source-code edit request and having a separate planner write one repair plan, requiring no learned monitor, no checkpoint search, and no extra model calls (search-free).
